description:
Crown Prix is a racing game designed exclusively for Apple Watch. Your Digital Crown becomes the steering wheel: turn it to carve through corners, feel every apex through your wrist, and chase the perfect lap on 24 real-world circuits. One lap, flat out — every run is a time attack against drivers around the world.

Apple Watch is REQUIRED to play the game

[Key Features]
- Digital Crown Steering: Steer with nothing but the crown. The throttle is handled for you — run wide open on the straights, then wind the crown to scrub speed through the corners. Pure, tactile racing built for the wrist.
- Full 2026 Calendar: All 24 circuits from the 2026 F1 season, from the tight hairpins of Monaco to the high-speed sweeps of Spa and Silverstone, each faithfully recreated from real track geometry.
- Purple Sectors: Every circuit is split into three timed sectors. Go green when you beat your personal best — go purple when you set the fastest sector time in the world.
- Global Leaderboards: A Game Center leaderboard for every circuit, plus sector record boards. See the world's top 10, your exact rank, and who owns each purple sector.
- World Championship: The top 10 drivers on each circuit score F1-style points (25-18-15...). Points across all 24 circuits combine into a global drivers' championship — climb the standings one lap at a time.
- Race-Day Presentation: Five red lights, then lights out. A live minimap, speed readout, and sector pills keep you on the pace, with haptic feedback for the start, every wall tap, and every new record.
- Make It Your Car: Choose from 8 liveries with a live preview, and see your color on track and on the minimap.
- iPhone Companion App: Browse every leaderboard, purple sector record, and the championship standings right from your iPhone.

No ads, no in-app purchases — pay once and race forever.

Thirty seconds is all a lap takes. Put on your watch, wait for lights out, and go claim your purple sectors.
promotionalText: Steer with your Digital Crown across all 24 circuits of the 2026 calendar. Chase purple sectors and climb the world championship — one flat-out lap at a time.
whatsNew:
The World Championship is here — and every leaderboard starts fresh. New season, clean grid, everything to race for.

[New]
- World Championship: The top 10 drivers on each circuit now score F1-style points (25-18-15...). Points from all 24 circuits combine into global standings — follow them on your Watch or in the new Championship tab on iPhone.
- Car colors: Choose from 8 liveries with a live preview. Your color shows on track and on the minimap.

[Improved]
- Fresh leaderboards: Every lap time and sector board has been reset for the new season. Set your times again and claim the early purple sectors.
- Long circuit and player names now scroll smoothly instead of getting cut off.
- Your personal bests sync from Game Center before every race.

[Fixed]
- Driving backwards across the line no longer counts as a lap. Nice try.
- New barriers at the Monaco and Circuit Gilles Villeneuve hairpins stop corner-cutting — honest laps only.

Lights out — the championship season starts now.
